description: This file defines a Java exception class 'JsonPointerInvalidException' used in the context of JSON Pointer validation. It provides methods for creating exceptions with specific error messages related to invalid JSON Pointer formats, such as consecutive slashes or leading/trailing slashes. The class includes a builder pattern for constructing instances with context-specific information.

classes.name: JsonPointerInvalidException
classes.description: An exception class representing invalid JSON Pointer errors, extending JsonRuntimeException, with static builder methods for specific error conditions.

classes.name: JsonPointerInvalidException.Builder
classes.description: A builder class for fluently constructing instances of JsonPointerInvalidException with specific messages and context.

methods.name: JsonPointerInvalidException.newBuilder
methods.description: Creates and returns a new builder for constructing JsonPointerInvalidException instances.

methods.name: JsonPointerInvalidException.newBuilderForConsecutiveSlashes
methods.description: Returns a builder pre-populated with a message indicating that consecutive slashes are not supported in JSON pointers.

methods.name: JsonPointerInvalidException.newBuilderForOuterSlashes
methods.description: Returns a builder pre-populated with a message indicating that leading/trailing slashes are not supported in JSON pointers.
